title: Discharge a patient
summary: More actions → Discharge: choose until when (1, 3, 6 or 12 months or a date). Readmit removes the discharge.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Discharge / Readmit
steps.details: If the patient isn't discharged, it opens the dialog. If they already are, it says «Readmit» and removes it when tapped.

steps.title: Quick options
steps.details: Discharge for 1, 3, 6 or 12 months: fills in the date.

steps.title: Discharge date
steps.details: Or choose a date by hand.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: The patient stays discharged until that date; it shows in the record's header.
